name: @avalon/api-client
description: Shared avalon-server API client + session store for Avalon's clients (hub, mobile-hub) — the one place fetch/WebSocket calls and the WebAuthn/signing-key auth ceremony live, so neither client duplicates the other's API code (issue #55/#60). Session token persistence is pluggable per app: hub keeps its existing localStorage default, mobile-hub injects a platform secure-storage adapter.
